verdict.rationale: Loops documents REST endpoints to create contacts (POST /contacts/create) and update them by email or userId (PUT /contacts/update), backed by a published OpenAPI spec and SDKs. The pack gives no evidence of API-based suppression or unsubscribe, only an indirect mention of contact properties, and nothing on scale characteristics. missing for 10: a documented suppress/unsubscribe API, explicit custom-property fields in the contact API, production-scale evidence (rate limits, bulk/batch operations), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale

citations.quote: POST /contacts/create Add a contact to your audience
PUT /contacts/update Update a contact by email or userId
The Loops API lets you manage contacts, send events and transactional email
Segments are dynamic and stay current as properties change.
